slide.slideTitle: A 41-minute pipeline cost every engineer an hour a day
keyBullets: 41 min median wait for a green build in July
3 pushes a day per engineer, on average
1 hour a day each, spent waiting or switching away
slide.speakerNotes: In July the median green build took 41 minutes. Our engineers push about three times a day, so the wait added up to roughly an hour each, every day, and most of that hour went to context switches rather than rest.

slide.slideTitle: Two stages ate 31 of the 41 minutes
keyBullets: Dependency install and the integration tests took 31 of 41 minutes
slide.speakerNotes: We timed every stage of a median July run. Dependency install took 14 minutes because the cache missed four times in five. The integration tests took 17 because one shard ran every slow test.

slide.slideTitle: One shared cache key, keyed on the lockfile alone
slide.subtitle: .github/workflows/ci.yml
keyBullets:
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/.cache/pnpm
    key: deps-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
    restore-keys: deps-${{ runner.os }}-
slide.speakerNotes: Before, each workflow built its own key from the branch name and the date, so almost every run missed. Now every workflow keys the cache on the lockfile alone, and restore-keys falls back to the newest cache for this OS when the lockfile changes.

slide.slideTitle: Split tests by last week's timings, longest first
